question: According to the Multidimensional poverty index 2021, which of the following states has the lowest percentage of multidimensional poor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) of 2021** was released by the **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) **and the **Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI)**.
 
• It was first launched in **2010**.
 
• As per the 2021 Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI), Kerala has the lowest percentage of multidimensionally poor people</strong&
